8. INSTALL FOUR OIL TUBES
Press the tubes by hand into the positions indicated in numerical order shown.
CAUTION: Make sure that the oil tubes or the two magnets do not interfere with the oil pan.

(4) (3) (2) (1)
AT0126

9. INSTALL PAN WITH NEW GASKET
Be sure the pan is clean and the two magnets are in place.
CAUTION: Do not use gasket sealer.
Tighten the bolts evenly.
Torque: 45 kg-cm (39 in.-lb, 4.4 N-m)

AT0145

10. INSTALL DRAIN PLUG
Torque the drain plug.
Torque: 205 kg-cm (15 ft-lb, 20 N-m)

AT0141

11. FILL TRANSMISSION WITH ATF
Add only about four quarts of ATF.
CAUTION: Do not overfill.
Fluid type: ATF DEXRON® II

12. CHECK FLUID LEVEL
(See page MA-13)

AT0162

REMOVAL OF THROTTLE CABLE

1. REMOVAL AIR CLEANER

2. DISCONNECT THROTTLE CABLE
(a) Disconnect the cable from the bracket on the cylinder head cover.
(b) Disconnect the cable from the throttle linkage.

AT0661
